lines.name: Rank AI sources by the value they send
lines.scope: Send CJA performance data into Brand Visibility, rank the AI sources by the visitors and conversions they send, and agree which sources the AI visibility work targets first.
lines.evidence: Send Customer Journey Analytics performance data into Brand Visibility

source.title: Experience League: Brand Visibility and CJA integration

lines.name: Journey audiences from CJA for activation
lines.scope: Define up to five audiences from cross-channel journey behavior in CJA, publish them to Experience Platform, and set up their activation in Real-Time CDP with your client.
lines.evidence: Audiences you define in Customer Journey Analytics can be published to Adobe Experience Platform

source.title: Experience League: How Experience Platform and its applications work together

lines.name: CJA audiences for Target, through Real-Time CDP or Journey Optimizer
lines.scope: Build journey audiences in CJA, publish them to Experience Platform, and share them with Target through the Adobe Target destination, which needs Real-Time CDP or Journey Optimizer and a Target-enabled datastream, for the agreed personalization activities.
lines.evidence: The Adobe Target destination is now available to organizations with Adobe Journey Optimizer, in addition to organizations with Real-Time CDP.
